settings.transcription_rel_tol_source: AMENDED 2026-11-23 after the first rehearsal stopped, before any further run (whip-lead yes, 2026-11-23): filed 1e-09 was a guess, not a measured floor; measured deviations from the saved arrays were vpd/x2 num 2.1e-8, den 2.4e-8, dd 4.2e-9 on an L40S, about 7e-8 on CPU, nn/x2 5e-16; 1e-6 is over 10x the largest measured. The rotation controls are unchanged.
settings.settings_source: windows: the cell (user 2026-11-23, 'the same 256 pairs per item'), read as the first min(256, |D|) windows of each item's D at every position. top_frac: the cell's top 1% most-needed. own_energy: the share of M's own write an own space must hold, exact for every one-direction variable (rank 1 holds all of it); the control stage checks it. rank_rtol: numerical rank of a stacked basis, a fp64 tolerance. too_small: whip-lead's floor (2026-11-23, filed with E273). too_wide: a needed space whose null exceeds one half is flagged. cache_batch, control, built: E268's (experiments/kstar_needed/results/predictions.json). head: whip-lead 2026-11-23, head (2, 4) at the head basis on E62's copy windows (E280's targets); its scan uses E268's scan settings loaded live (4 derangements x 64, seed 268). panel_vpd_derangements: one seeded derangement, a departure from E272's four to keep the rescan short (plan section 3). theta_deg: redteam-lead's rotation control, an angle large enough that the own and needed parts differ by far more than fp64 rounding. rot_other_max: the control toward a non-needed column stops the job above one half (both nulls sit near dim S / 768, a few hundredths). order_tol, transcription_rel_tol: fp64 summation bounds over at most 16,384 rows and 389 variables, rounded up. seed: the E-number, the matched null's draw.

readings.strict: the frozen kept: commute.stand_in.explained(num, den) per variable over dd, pooled as explained_share over the read set N
readings.own: per variable the part of dd in O(u), the fewest top eigen-directions of W_M^T W_M holding own_energy of its trace; pooled: parts summed over N over dd summed over N
readings.needed: the same in S(u) = span of O(u) and O(v) for every non-remainder v of the reference set R at u's site (VPD: the matrix; neuron basis: the layer's MLP for neurons and remainder, the layer's attention for heads), numerical rank at rank_rtol
readings.matched: the same in A(u) = span of O(u) and as many O(v) as S(u) uses, v drawn with the seed from the site's non-remainder variables outside R and N (redteam-lead's anisotropy-matched null)
readings.nu: per variable dim S / d_out, the expected part of a random direction; pooled weighted by dd
readings.rotation: pooled (needed - own) / (dd - own): the share of the change leaving the own spaces that lands in the needed spaces; read against two nulls: the same with matched for needed, and the dd - own weighted (dim S - dim O) / (d_out - dim O)
readings.pooling: the read pools over the non-remainder members of N; the same pooled with remainders is reported beside it, with the non-remainder share of N's dd
readings.sets: N: the ceil(top_frac n) changed members of K with most flips (saved scan); R: the ceil(top_frac n) members of K with most flips; ties to the lower index
readings.head24: head (2, 4) alone, on E62's 206 copy windows: strict and own share, its null dim O / 768, and its flips of 256 pairs from needed_neurons.scan with pairs drawn within the copy windows

rules.R0: The control stage stops the job unless each do-nothing (vpd, nn) has no changed variable, an empty read set, every accumulated dd exactly 0.0, pooled strict, own, needed and matched exactly 1.0, and every own space holding at least own_energy of its write (to 1e-12)
rules.R1: x2 at nn stops the job unless every changed non-remainder member of N has own share at least 1 - 1e-9 and the pooled own share is at least 0.99 (x2 scales down_proj columns, so each neuron's change lies along its own column). x2 at both bases stops the job unless N's summed num, den and dd repeat the saved arrays (E247 at vpd, E277 at nn) within transcription_rel_tol
rules.R2: On every item the job stops if any one-direction variable reads strict above own, or any variable own above needed or matched, by more than order_tol times its dd (all hold by construction)
rules.R3: Built rotation controls at nn on x2's D and M, before any trained read: neuron i (the most-flipping neuron of R with another R neuron j at its layer) has its output column turned by theta_deg at fixed norm. (i) Toward j: own share must be (1 - cos theta) / 2 within 1e-6 and the rotation share at least 1 - 1e-6. (ii) Toward k (the fewest-flipping neuron of that layer outside K, else outside R): own share as (i), rotation share at most rot_other_max. A miss stops the job. The own share is the change's, not the write's: the change W_F - W_M of a column turned by theta has the fraction (1 - cos theta) / 2 of its norm along W_M (redteam-lead's cos^2 theta is F's write's share, a different quantity)
rules.items: descriptive (card); no verdict on reuse under this reading

expected.control: do-nothing at both bases: as R0. Rotation controls at theta 30 degrees: own 0.0669873 in both; rotation (i) 1, (ii) near its nulls (a few hundredths)
expected.x2_x10_neurons: own share at least 1 - 1e-9 per changed neuron, pooled own at least 0.99; rotation share none (nothing leaves the own spaces)
expected.x2_x10_vpd: needed share pooled at least the strict share (E268: E_b 0.761 over K); expected at least 0.9
expected.new_few_new_thin: needed share pooled at most 0.5; rotation share within 0.1 of both nulls, at both bases. new_thin's pooled read rests on its non-remainder change, about 1% of N's dd (redteam-lead's estimate), reported as nonrem_dd_share
expected.randoms: built randoms and E229's matched randoms: rotation share within 0.05 of the matched null; own share 0.2 to 0.8 at the neuron basis (a Gaussian moves a neuron's input and output side by similar relative amounts)
expected.e62: rival A (rotation): the three-seed mean of copy's needed share at least 0.2 above lookup's, at either basis; rival B: within 0.2
expected.e229_panel: descriptive: each trained item's rotation share beside its matched random's and its two nulls; rival A puts trained at least 0.2 above the matched null on most items, rival B within 0.05 of it
expected.head24: strict: copy above lookup on every seed (E277 on all of D: copy 0.095-0.141, lookup 0.015-0.020); flips: copy above lookup on every seed (E277 on all of D: 128-141 against 11-15 of 256); own share, copy beside lookup, each against its null dim O / 768 (at most 0.17): rival A (rotation inside the head's write space) puts every copy seed at 0.5 or more and above lookup, rival B below 0.5
expected.time: control stage about 10 min (two do-nothings, two x2 reads, two rotation controls); about 1 min per item without a scan, measured by x2; head24 6 min; VPD panel about 4 min per state on an H100 (E272: 742 s per state at 4 derangements on an H100, divided by 4, plus the read)

gauge.added: 2026-11-24, definition-lead (writer agent), at whip-lead's request (redteam-lead's note ~/commute-data/agents/whip-lead/note-2026-11-24-redteam-p271-lit-challenges.md item 4), before the gauge stage ran. Every setting, reading, rule and expected value above is unchanged; this block adds the stage `gauge` (experiments/rotation_kept/gauge.py)

settings.settings_source: seed: the E-number then the date. floor_mult: the gauged model's logits must lie within 10 times the round-trip floor (the gauge then its transpose, the same fp32 casts twice) of M's. scale_tol: fp32 rounding of a gauged weight is about 6e-8 relative, so a head write's squared relative change is near 1e-14; 1e-9 leaves wide room

readings.gauge_map: per head, QK: W_q -> G W_q, W_k -> G W_k with G a random turn of each rotary pair of head dimensions (the only orthogonal maps that commute with the rotary embedding, so the only QK gauge here); VO: W_v -> S W_v, W_O -> W_O S^T, S random orthogonal (commute.head_gauge.rotate)
readings.invariance: max |logits(F_gauge) - logits(M)| over x2's D, against the round-trip floor
readings.shares: strict, own and needed shares (run.py measure, x2's ranking) of F_gauge against M at the neuron-and-head basis and at VPD; beside them max dd / den over the non-remainder read set, and kept at write scale 1 - sum (dd - part) / sum den for the strict and needed parts
readings.tangent: per trained state, the part of its update's squared norm on the head matrices (q, k, v, o) along the gauge's tangent at M: QK per rotary pair span{(I_p W_q, -I_p W_k), (J_p W_q, J_p W_k)}, VO {(A W_v, -W_O A)} by least squares (commute.head_gauge.tangent_share); beside the same for a random update matched per tensor

rules.G0: The stage stops unless F_gauge's logits lie within floor_mult times the round-trip floor of M's
rules.G1: descriptive; a miss of the expected values below is reported as found, with no amendment

expected.nn: reads 1: only heads change; max dd / den at most scale_tol and kept at write scale (strict) at least 1 - scale_tol. The pooled shares are of a change at the fp32 floor and carry no meaning there
expected.vpd: may not read 1: q_proj, k_proj, v_proj and o_proj are decomposed matrix by matrix, so the gauge moves their subcomponents' writes by a relative amount of order 1 while the function is unchanged. Reported as found
expected.tangent: matched random: about 128 x 128 / (4 x 128 x 768) = 0.042 of the head norm (VO) plus 0.0003 (QK), the tangent's share of the head parameters. Trained updates (E62, E229 pairs, panel): not filed; above about 0.1 reads as gauge motion large enough to bear on the head readings (redteam-lead: Adam has a component along the gauge, gradient descent none)
expected.time: invariance and two basis reads about 5 min; tangent about 5 s per state over 65 states (9 E62, 20 E229, 36 panel), about 10 min with world loads; one debug job

gauge_follow.added: 2026-11-24, definition-lead (writer agent), at whip-lead's request (redteam-lead's verdict ~/commute-data/agents/definition-lead/notes-read/note-2026-11-23-redteam-p160-gauge-verdict.md), after the gauge stage g0 ran (a3f86840) and before gauge_pool and gauge_sub ran. Every setting, reading, rule and expected value above, the gauge block's included, is unchanged; this block adds two stages (experiments/rotation_kept/gauge_follow.py)

settings.settings_source: pool_bar: 100 times g0's measured head-basis floor (results/gauge_g0.json nn.max_rel_change 1.237e-12, the gauge's fp32 rounding at the head basis); the factor 100 is chosen, for the extra fp32 rounding of rebuilding the attention matrices from VPD pieces. pieces_tol: the largest relative error of M rebuilt from the VPD pieces (kstar_vpd.featurize checks) allowed before gauge_sub refuses a state's M as not the decomposed model

readings.gauge_pool: g0's gauged M (gauge seed 286024) featurized at VPD; q, k, v and o rebuilt from the VPD pieces on each side and each layer's attention pooled into one variable, its write the layer's attention output (rotation_kept.Attention). VPD subcomponents of q, k, v and o each span all six heads of a layer, so the layer, not the head, is the finest pool the pieces define (redteam-lead asked for per head; per head is not defined from these pieces). Beside it, the same pool built from the weights directly (no VPD rebuild). Read: max dd / den over the four layers and kept at write scale, 1 - sum (dd - part) / sum den, strict and needed
readings.gauge_sub: per trained state of E62 (9) and E229 (20): F, and F with the gauge component of its head-matrix update removed (head_gauge.tangent_component, g0's projection), each featurized at VPD and read over the same read set N (E62: E275's saved K; E229: K found on F with panel_vpd_derangements derangements of E268's pairs, as panel_vpd); pooled strict and needed shares, non-remainder, and their change. Classes: E62 copy, lookup, lookup at copy's size (3 seeds each); E229 each task (2 seeds). The unremoved reading is computed in this stage; the main stage's VPD reading is copied beside it when present

rules.P0: gauge_pool: descriptive; reads about 1 when max dd / den over the pooled layers is at most pool_bar and kept at write scale (strict) is at least 1 - pool_bar. A miss is reported as found, with no amendment
rules.S0: gauge_sub: a state stops unless M rebuilt from its VPD pieces is within pieces_tol
rules.S1: gauge_sub, per class and per share (strict, needed): the gauge component's removal moves the reading by less than one seed sd when the mean over seeds of |removed - update| is below the sample sd over seeds of the update's reading, both measured in this stage. Only when every class moves by less than one seed sd may 'the gauge does not explain the low kept share' be said for E62 and E229

expected.gauge_pool: about 1: the pooled attention output is a function of the whole layer's q, k, v and o, which the gauge leaves unchanged; within pool_bar. The weights-only pool reads 1 at g0's head floor
expected.gauge_sub: every class moves by less than one seed sd: the trained updates put about 1% of their head norm on the gauge (g0: median 0.007-0.012), so removing it should barely move the reading; a class that moves by one sd or more is reported as found
expected.time: gauge_pool about 5 min. gauge_sub: E62 about 2 min per state (two featurizations, two reads; the main stage's VPD items took about that), E229 about 3.5 min per state (adds a one-derangement VPD scan on 512 windows of 8 tokens: E281 read 256 pairs of 38,938 variables in 128 s on an H100, so 64 pairs about 32 s, about 80 s on an L40), about 1.5 h in all, as two debug jobs of half the states

headnull.added: 2026-11-23, definition-lead (writer agent), at whip-lead's request relaying the user ('re-run with better controls if you think thats good'), before run_headnull.py ran. Every setting, reading, rule and expected value above, the gauge and gauge_follow blocks' included, is unchanged; this block adds experiments/rotation_kept/run_headnull.py, results in results/headnull/. Descriptive: a random null for one paper sentence

settings.settings_source: bases: the six fine-tunes E286's head24 stage and E277's e62 stage read (settings head_states). Each base gets one random update, `needed_neurons.matched_random` (E277's 'matched random', also gauge.py's): a Gaussian per parameter tensor that F changed, scaled to the Frobenius norm of F - M on that tensor, so the random matches its fine-tune's size tensor by tensor (and so in total), not its KL; seed random_seed + the base's index in bases. control: E280's built edit v2 (head 4's v_proj rows of layer 2 times 2: its write exactly doubled), which E280 read at the head featurization as kept 0.9999999999999999 on all of D (experiments/head_edit/results/items/v2_neurons.json). control_tol: E286's order_tol, an fp64 summation bound, against E280's measured deviation of 1.1e-16. The two readings' scan and write-pass settings are E277's (all of D) and E268's loaded live (copy windows), as their sources ran; top_frac, own_energy, rank_rtol, cache_batch, seed and transcription_rel_tol are E286's settings above
settings.saved_rel_tol_source: AMENDED 2026-11-23 after run 1 (h0) stopped at H1, before any rerun (whip-lead yes, 2026-11-23 ~23:05, note-2026-11-23-whip-e295-rerun.md). Old bar: E286 transcription_rel_tol 1e-6, a guess, not a measured floor at this site. Measured at this site: e62/copy_s0 whole_d.kept 0.13119079052694657 here vs 0.13119063378631132 saved by E277 on another card, relative 1.19e-6 (absolute 1.6e-7); copy.strict 0 and copy.own 1.4e-16 off. New bar 1e-4 relative, ~80x the measured cross-card difference. Only H1 reads it; R1 and the controls keep their tolerances.

readings.whole_d: E277's head (2, 4) columns (needed_neurons run.py read_item, head24_columns) on all 512 windows of D (E187's read half: copy windows, windows without the cue and far text), at the last position: kept = explained / dd of the one variable L2.h4 from one write_pass, and its flips over E277's 256 pairs (4 derangements x 64). This is the reading behind the paper's 0.095-0.141 copy and 0.015-0.020 lookup
readings.copy: E286's head24 reading on D's 206 copy windows (head_edit.targets), every position: the strict, own-space and needed-space shares of L2.h4's write change, the reference set R the top 1% of K by flips from this item's own scan of the copy windows (E268's settings, 256 pairs), the rotation share (needed - own) / (dd - own) with its dimension-count null, the own space's and needed space's dimension over the width (a random direction's shares), and its flips. E286 read the same strict, own and flips (0.130-0.187 copy, 0.005-0.013 lookup); the needed-space share is new here
readings.order: stage 0 first and alone in every job: the identity interchange on v2's copy windows, then the do-nothing, then v2; then per base the fine-tune and its random

rules.H0: stage 0 stops the job unless: the identity interchange (x' = x) on the copy windows changes no argmax; the do-nothing (a copy of M) reads dd exactly 0 at both readings and strict, own and needed exactly 1 (the dd-0 convention); v2 reads kept on all of D and strict on the copy windows at least 1 - control_tol, own within control_tol of the share of M's write its own space holds (at least own_energy), and needed at least own - control_tol
rules.H1: each fine-tune stops the job unless it repeats E286's saved strict and own (results/items/head24__<item>.json) and E277's saved kept (needed_neurons results/large/items_<item>.npz) within transcription_rel_tol, relative; flips are recorded beside the saved ones, not checked (argmax ties may differ across cards)
rules.H2: every item stops the job on an ordering miss (own above needed beyond order_tol * dd)
rules.randoms: descriptive, no bar. Read per arm as the range over its three randoms beside its three fine-tunes, for the strict and kept shares

expected.do_nothing: kept, strict, own, needed 1; dd 0; flips descriptive (M's own dependence on the head: near the lookup fine-tunes' (11-15 of 256 on all of D, 0-1 on the copy windows) if the copy fine-tune made the head's role, near copy's (128-141, 245-252) if M already copies through it)
expected.v2: kept and strict 1 - 1e-16; own about 0.99 (the share its 99%-energy own space holds), needed at least that; flips descriptive (E280 read 60 of 256 on all of D)
expected.fine_tunes: repeat the saved values: all of D kept 0.095-0.141 copy, 0.015-0.020 lookup, flips 128-141 copy, 11-15 lookup; copy windows strict 0.130-0.187 copy, 0.005-0.013 lookup, own 0.80-0.86, flips 245-252 copy, 0-1 lookup
expected.randoms: strict and kept near the realistic panel's Gaussian and the toy matched randoms (E286: 0.009 pooled), about 0.01-0.02. Randoms near 0.01-0.02 on both readings: the copy head's 0.1 is above a size-matched random, and the paper's copy-head sentence stands as a contrast with chance. Randoms near 0.1 (within the copy seeds' range): a random update of that size keeps as much of the head's role, so the copy-head sentence must change. Between: reported as read, with the gap to each arm. Own about 0.6 (E286's random updates at heads, 0.59-0.67), needed at least own; flips: near the lookup fine-tunes if a random update breaks the copy head's role no more than lookup does
expected.time: per item about 77 s for the copy windows (E286's head24, L40S pod, 76-91 s per item) plus about 39 s for all of D (E277's e62 stage, 39 s per item after the first) = about 2 min; 14 items (do-nothing, v2, 6 fine-tunes, 6 randoms) about 27 min on an L40S, so two debug L40 jobs of 3 bases each, stage 0 in both: about 2 + 2 x 2 + 6 x 2 = 18 min each, more on an L40

amendments: 2026-11-23: H1 reads saved_rel_tol (1e-4 relative) in place of transcription_rel_tol (1e-6); see settings saved_rel_tol_source. Both tolerances are reported with the result.
